blockers: B1 - The game never contacts the RGS. src/stake/rgs.ts is dead code (only importer is jurisdiction.svelte.ts:19, for one constant); createRgsClient/readStakeLaunch/authenticate/play/endRound have zero call sites and no file outside src/stake/ issues a wallet request. The shipped slot spins on a local mulberry32 RNG, scores itself with a client-side evaluator and pays from a self-granted 1,000-unit demo wallet (SlotApp.svelte:114, :224, :694-706); Felix's Flight spends the same wallet via createDemoFlightRgs (SlotApp.svelte:1467). rgs.ts:276-285 claims an unlaunched build renders a fatal notice - main.ts:69-71 mounts the game unconditionally. Fails checklist 20, 22, 24, 26, 27, 28, 30, 31, 32, 33, 36.

B2 - Social mode is unreachable and every restricted word ships. setSocial() has zero callers (social.svelte.ts:25 is the only hit repo-wide), so isSocial() is permanently false; socialLabel()/betWord()/buyWord() have zero call sites in any rendered component. The control bar draws the literal 'BET' (ControlBar.svelte:529, :765) and the rules render Paytable, paylines, pays, no cash, payout, BUY, Buy {label} unscrubbed (MenuModal.svelte:192, 198, 490, 538, 544, 550, 595, 662, 676, 702, 719). Trap T1 plus findings 4.6 and 6.6, with the mechanism absent rather than under-inclusive. Fails checklist 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12, 14.

B3 - No disclaimer. Stake's approval-disclaimer.svx states games submitted without one 'will not pass approval' and lists seven required points; the build carries one sentence, 'Malfunction voids all pays and plays.' (MenuModal.svelte:1162). Missing internet requirement, disconnection recovery, expected-return-over-many-plays, display accuracy, payout source and copyright. The payout-source point is contradicted outright by MenuModal.svelte:1156-1159, which tells the player the outcome is drawn locally at the press of SPIN. Fails checklist 56.

B4 - No bet replay. readReplayLaunch() and fetchReplayBook() (rgs.ts:139, :502) are never called, setReplayMode() (jurisdiction.svelte.ts:37) is never called, and main.ts has no ?replay=true branch - a replay URL loads the ordinary demo game with a fresh 1,000-unit balance. Fails checklist 73, 74, 75, 76, 77, 109.
findings: F1 - Currency never read from launch params: setCurrency() (money.svelte.ts:75) is called once at module load with its own USD default (:90); readStakeLaunch parses currency (rgs.ts:133) and nothing consumes it. Every session renders USD. Checklist 19.

F2 - The formatter reproduces reviewer finding 3.2 verbatim. money.svelte.ts:82-85 builds Intl.NumberFormat with no fraction-digit pins. Measured: KWD balance 10,000,000,000.000 and bet KWD 0.400; JPY bet 0.4 -> Yen 0; 147.70 -> Yen 148, i.e. money rounded UP (C8). Checklist 16, 18.

F3 - Per-frame src swaps at up to 1,200 assignments per second. WinCelebration.svelte:273 runs setInterval(frame += 1, COIN_SPIN_MS=80) (coinShower.ts:57) and :338 swaps each petal's src off that counter, with MAX_PETALS=96 (flowerShower.ts:75). With 'Disable cache' ticked - the protocol behind 'a high number of invalid requests' - that is ~1,200 cancelled requests per second for the duration of every big win. Trap T9(a). Checklist 59.

F4 - Debug rigs in the production build, three ways: dist/wild-preview/index.html ships as a page titled 'Expanding wild - reel builder' (deliberate, vite.config.ts:35-45); main.ts:60-69 mounts ?build-ew, ?build-egg, ?build-fs and ?type off the main URL; ForcePanel.svelte:50-55 arms an outcome-forcing dev panel on any build via ?force or ?force-event, confirmed present in dist/assets/slotapp-iw9e00ee.js. Checklist 88.

F5 - Hit-rate and probability numbers in player copy: MenuModal.svelte:680-682 'free spins arrive about 1 in {n} spins instead of 1 in {m}', :666-667 '{n}x as often', and About-tab lines :1140-1146 '1 spin in {n}' and 'once in {n} spins'. Checklist 57 and trap T12's inverse rule.

F6 - No spacebar-to-bet. Stake's frontend requirement is explicit; space is handled only at FelixFlight.svelte:6355 (dismiss a payout card), RoundGate.svelte:231 (button activation) and src/dev/PaylinePreview.svelte:44. Checklist 41.

F7 - Insufficient funds does nothing: SlotApp.svelte:695 returns early with no message, no notice and no request; the button stays lit and silent. Round 3.5 asked for a clickable button AND a message. Checklist 24.

F8 - Bet ladder is a hardcoded literal: config.ts:97 BET_STEPS_DISPLAY = [0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50], consumed at SlotApp.svelte:205. The careful betLevels/minBet/maxBet/stepBet clamping at rgs.ts:381-401 is unreachable. On a JPY session every rung is below minimum. Checklist 20, 22, 29.

F9 - Jurisdiction flags inert: setLimits() (jurisdiction.svelte.ts:49) has no callers, so all flags are permanently permissive; independently noTurbo(), noSpacebar() and minRoundMs() are honoured in no component - only noAutoplay() and noBuyFeature() are read. Checklist 37.

F10 - 90.05% of base spins pay nothing, on Stake's written rejection line. scripts/math-sim.mjs seed 20260828, 4,000,000 base spins: nothing 3,602,142 = 90.0536%, hit rate 9.9465% (1 in 10.05). Stake's math doc names '90,000 non-paying out of 100,000' as possible grounds for rejection; the checklist band is 1-in-3 to 1-in-8. Checklist 98.

F11 - Declared RTP is not the model's RTP and 29% of it is a literal. The rules table prints 96.50% for all eight modes (MenuModal.svelte:448, from GAME.targetRtp) while the game's own exact model returns 96.3984%. FEATURE_GAIN = 0.282916 (rtp.ts:247) is a hardcoded 28.29 points, and simulate() (rtp.ts:483-530) models neither the shot nor the eggs - which is why the same script measures the base at 67.72%. The cross-check cannot check 29% of its own headline. Checklist 101.

F12 - The math pack does not exist as an artefact. `npm run verify:math` refuses: 'no pack at math-sdk/games/vegan_spins/library/publish_files - run npm run math:pack first - it is a build artefact and is not committed.' `npm run math:pack` did not complete in 10 minutes. No books, no lookup tables, no index.json to diff against config.ts. Checklist 100.

F13 - Max-win headroom thin against Stake's stated bar: docs/MAXWIN-50000.md:21 puts the 50,000x cap at 1 in 19.6 million base spins - inside the checklist's 1-in-20,000,000 by 2%, outside Stake's own 'typically more frequent than 1 in 10,000,000'. Checklist 97.

F14 - Three of eight purchasable modes cannot reach the advertised ceiling: Felix's tiers cap at MAX_SKY_WIN 9,257x against the game's 50,000x (config.ts:113-120). Correctly disclosed per-mode (MenuModal.svelte:497-506), so finding 6.3 is closed; the residue is commercial rather than compliance.

F15 - html is missing overflow:hidden. app.css:52-67 sets height:100% on html, body and #app but puts overflow:hidden on body alone, and there is no global canvas { display: block } - every canvas rule is container-scoped. Latent rather than live (body overflow propagates to the viewport), but it is the exact configuration behind T14's 4px scroll. Checklist 64.
F16 - WebGL context-loss recovery exists only on the flight surface (FelixFlight.svelte:1992); the slot stage, which owns the main renderer, has none. Checklist 92.
F17 - One console.log survives into the shipped bundle (dist/assets/money.svelte-jjixxsjr.js). Checklist 63.

PASSES worth recording: filename law clean (862 files, scripts/filename-law.mjs); zero beforeunload handlers; zero web-sdk sample assets (804 dist media/JSON hashed against six sample apps, 0 collisions); zero external origins; sub-path serve verified at /vegan-spins/v1/ (index, entry chunk and deep rig asset all 200); the compact layout is selected on pure geometry with an explicit 'no pointer test' and derives COMPACT_MIN_H from the 400x225 pop-out (barPortrait.ts:194-270) - the best-handled trap in the repo; a per-mode RTP/max-win table built from the owning modules (MenuModal.svelte:437-506); no links, no emoji, no manual bet entry, autoplay behind a confirmation panel; 902 tests pass across 54 files.

ABSENT AND SCORED AS ABSENT: audio. `find` over the whole repository returns zero .mp3/.ogg/.wav/.m4a files, and the product says so itself at MenuModal.svelte:1124 - 'This game has no audio yet.' This is the axis (defect corpus P1) that produced a real reviewer's 1.33 for a game that at least had two working cues.
lift: Wire createRgsClient into SlotApp.svelte and route every spin through authenticate -> play -> endRound, taking the bet ladder, the default bet, the currency and the jurisdiction limits from the authenticate response. One change: it clears B1 and takes F1, F8 and F9 with it, and turns the artefact from an offline demo of a slot into a Stake game with a fix list - which is the difference between a score below the publishing bar and one on it. The client is already written and correct; SlotApp.svelte:1459 names the swap.
